title: Albéa unveils new packaging concepts for makeup, skincare and fragrance
summary: Albéa brought together its Cosmetics & Fragrance and Tubes businesses at Luxe Pack Monaco 2026, held September 28–30, to showcase new packaging collections, applicator technologies and tube decoration solutions. The event also marked 70 years of Albéa Tubes in France, where the company launched the first plastic cosmetic tube in 1956 as an alternative to aluminum. At Luxe Pack Monaco, Albéa showcased its latest beauty packaging innovations, focusing on four key areas: eco-design,... - Packaging & design
